dead end at the same yard line as Ramsay

notes: Street names printed without suffix (BAYMILLER, RAMSAY, MILL); 'Street' added. Alley printed 'WEST ALLEY' (20 ft), recorded as West Alley. Baymiller is 66 ft north of W. 3rd and 45 ft south of it; the 45 ft part crosses the C.C.C.&St.L. yard as a dashed (unopened) street to W. Front, and Baymiller lies along the left margin so only its east half is on the sheet south of W. 3rd. Mill is 50 ft north of W. Front and 60 ft south of it. W. Front has two water pipes (20 in and 4 in) plus a switch track; the 66 ft label sits between the north line and the 20 in pipe, which runs about 33 ft from the north line, so the 20 in pipe is used as the centreline (y = 2115 + 0.4875(x-1500)). Near Mill the north frontage of W. Front flattens (lot 800) and the street flares, and W. Front jogs at Mill (see sheet 1), so Mill/W. Front here is the centre of the open area between the four corners and is less certain (about +/-25 px); sheet 1 shows this junction more fully. Mill/W. 2nd is at the right edge, W. 2nd entering from the east. Stone St. ends at W. 3rd from the north (no width label read). Mill at W. 3rd: Mill crosses the yard (footbridge labels 'Foot Bridge'/'Iron Bridge' at y~1290).
